Class SwapCommand

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.chat.cmd.SwapCommand
All Implemented Interfaces:
Command
public class SwapCommand extends Object implements Command
The SwapCommand type is the swap command. The form is swap followed by a from word and a to word. The command stores the to word when this console family is Ollama, or when no family is stored. Ollama is the program that runs a local model. The from word is required. The from word is not sent to a process. A family of grok or pool leaves the stored target unchanged. // @aa-sdd G-15 aetheris-stages-1-3.finalize.md

      private final int numCtx

  • Constructor Details

    • SwapCommand

      public SwapCommand(String baseUrl, int numCtx)
      The constructor stores the Ollama HTTP base and the token window. If baseUrl is null or empty, the stored base is http://localhost:11434. trimSlash(String) removes one trailing slash from any other base. execute(CommandContext, String) does not read the stored base or the stored window.
      Parameters:
      baseUrl - The Ollama HTTP base.
      numCtx - The token window, where 0 means num_ctx is not sent.

    • execute

      public void execute(CommandContext ctx, String args) throws Exception
      The execute method stores a model name or reports the current family. A null remainder is treated as empty. The line must contain a from word, a space, and a to word. If either word is missing, the method throws Exception with the message usage: swap <from> <to>. If the console family is null, empty, or ollama, the method stores the to word and writes model plus that word. Any other family writes The console family is plus the family word and does not change the stored target. Each written line ends with a carriage return and a line feed.
      Specified by:
      execute in interface Command
      Parameters:
      ctx - The shell resources for this connection.
      args - The remainder of the line after the command name.
      Throws:
      Exception - The from word or the to word was missing.

      private static String trimSlash(String url)
      The trimSlash method removes one trailing slash from a base URL. If the text does not end with /, the method returns it unchanged.
      Parameters:
